name: bare-events

exports.name: EventEmitter
signatures:
interface EventEmitter<in out M extends Record<keyof M, unknown[]> = EventMap> {
  addListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  addOnceListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  prependListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  prependOnceListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  removeListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  removeAllListeners<E extends keyof M>(name?: E): this
  on<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  once<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  off<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
  emit<E extends keyof M>(name: E, ...args: M[E]): boolean
  listeners<E extends keyof M>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E]>[]
  rawListeners<E extends keyof M>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E]>[]
  eventNames(): (keyof M)[]
  listenerCount<E extends keyof M>(name: E): number
  getMaxListeners(): number
  setMaxListeners(n: number): this
}
exports.description:
An emitter of named events to which listener functions can be attached, closely mirroring
Node.js's `EventEmitter`.

members.name: addListener
signatures: addListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
members.description:
Add `fn` as a listener for `name`, called on every subsequent emit. Returns `this` for
chaining.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to listen for.

params.name: fn
params.description: The listener function, called with the event's arguments on each emit.

members.name: addOnceListener
signatures: addOnceListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
members.description:
Add `fn` as a listener for `name` that is removed after it fires once. Returns `this` for
chaining.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to listen for.

params.name: fn
params.description: The listener function, called once with the event's arguments then removed.

members.name: emit
signatures: emit<E extends keyof M>(name: E, ...args: M[E]): boolean
members.description:
Synchronously call each listener registered for `name`, in registration order, with `args`.
Returns `true` if there were listeners, `false` otherwise. Emitting `'error'` with no `'error'`
listeners throws the error asynchronously instead of calling any listener.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to emit.

params.name: args
params.description: Arguments passed to each listener registered for `name`.

members.name: EventEmitter.defaultMaxListeners
members.description: The default max-listeners value used by `getMaxListeners()`.

members.name: EventEmitter.forward
signatures: EventEmitter.forward<F extends Record<keyof F, unknown[]>, E extends keyof F, T extends Record<keyof T, unknown[]> & Pick<F, E>>(from: EventEmitter<F>, to: EventEmitter<T>, names: E | E[], opts?: { emit?: (name: E, ...args: T[E]) => void }): void
members.description:
Forward events named in `names` from `from` to `to`, re-emitting them on `to` only while `to`
has at least one listener for that event.

params.name: from
params.description: The emitter to forward events from.

params.name: to
params.description: The emitter to forward events to.

params.name: names
params.description: The event name, or array of event names, to forward.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Options; `emit` overrides how forwarded events are re-emitted on `to` (defaults
to `to.emit`).

members.name: EventEmitter.getMaxListeners
members.description: Return the maximum number of listeners for `emitter`.

params.name: emitter
params.description: The emitter to query.

returns.description:
`emitter.getMaxListeners()` if the emitter has that method, otherwise
`EventEmitter.defaultMaxListeners`.

members.name: EventEmitter.listenerCount
signatures: EventEmitter.listenerCount<M extends Record<keyof M, unknown[]>, E extends keyof M>(emitter: EventEmitter<M>, name: E): number
members.description:
Return the number of listeners registered on `emitter` for `name`, by calling the emitter's
own `listenerCount` method.

params.name: emitter
params.description: The emitter to query.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to count listeners for.

members.name: EventEmitter.on
signatures: EventEmitter.on<M extends Record<keyof M, unknown[]>, E extends keyof M>(emitter: EventEmitter<M>, name: E, opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal }): AsyncIterableIterator<M[E]>
members.description:
Iterate the `name` events emitted by `emitter`, yielding the arguments of each emit as an
array. Unless `name` is `'error'`, an `'error'` event on `emitter` ends the iteration by
rejecting with the emitted error.

params.name: emitter
params.description: The emitter to iterate events from.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to iterate.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `signal` aborts the iteration, rejecting it with an `EventEmitterError`.

returns.description:
An async iterator of the emitted arguments, which stops listening once it is returned
from or throws.

members.name: EventEmitter.once
signatures: EventEmitter.once<M extends Record<keyof M, unknown[]>, E extends keyof M>(emitter: EventEmitter<M>, name: E, opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<M[E]>
members.description:
Wait for the next `name` event emitted by `emitter`. Unless `name` is `'error'`, an `'error'`
event on `emitter` rejects the wait with the emitted error instead.

params.name: emitter
params.description: The emitter to wait on.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to wait for.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Options; `signal` aborts the wait, rejecting the promise with an
`EventEmitterError`.

returns.description: A promise resolving with the arguments of the next emit, as an array.

members.name: EventEmitter.setMaxListeners
members.description: Set the maximum number of listeners on each of `emitters` that has a `setMaxListeners` method.

params.name: n
params.description: The maximum number of listeners to allow.

params.name: emitters
params.description:
The emitters to apply the new limit to; if omitted, sets
`EventEmitter.defaultMaxListeners` instead.

members.name: eventNames
members.description: Return an array of the event names that currently have listeners.

members.name: getMaxListeners
members.description: Return the maximum number of listeners allowed for this emitter.

returns.description:
`EventEmitter.defaultMaxListeners`; bare-events does not track a per-instance limit
separately.

members.name: listenerCount
signatures: listenerCount<E extends keyof M>(name: E): number
members.description: Return the number of listeners registered for `name`, or `0` if there are none.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to count listeners for.

members.name: listeners
signatures: listeners<E extends keyof M>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E]>[]
members.description: Return a copy of the listener array for `name`.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to return the listener array for.

members.name: prependListener
signatures: prependListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
members.description: Like `addListener`, but adds `fn` to the beginning of the listener list instead of the end.

params.name: name

params.name: fn
params.description: The listener function to add to the front of the listener list instead of the end.

returns.description: The emitter itself, for chaining, like `addListener`.

members.name: prependOnceListener
signatures: prependOnceListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
members.description: Like `addOnceListener`, but adds `fn` to the beginning of the listener list instead of the end.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to listen for.

params.name: fn
params.description:
The listener function to add to the front of the listener list, removed after it
fires once.

returns.description: The emitter itself, for chaining, like `addOnceListener`.

members.name: rawListeners
signatures: rawListeners<E extends keyof M>(name: E): EventHandler<M[E]>[]
members.description:
Return a copy of the listener array for `name`, including one-time wrapper listeners as
registered.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to return the raw listener array for.

members.name: removeAllListeners
signatures: removeAllListeners<E extends keyof M>(name?: E): this
members.description: Remove all listeners, or only those for `name` if given. Returns `this` for chaining.

params.name: name
params.description:
If given, remove listeners only for this event name; otherwise remove all
listeners for every event.

members.name: removeListener
signatures: removeListener<E extends keyof M>(name: E, fn: EventHandler<M[E]>): this
members.description: Remove one instance of `fn` from the listeners for `name`. Returns `this` for chaining.

params.name: name
params.description: The event name to remove the listener from.

params.name: fn
params.description: The listener function to remove.

members.name: setMaxListeners
members.description:
Set the maximum number of listeners for this emitter. Accepted for compatibility, but the
limit is not recorded and the call has no effect.

params.name: n
params.description: The maximum number of listeners to allow.

exports.name: EventEmitterError
exports.description:
The error class used for emitter-internal errors, such as an unhandled `'error'` event or an
aborted `events.on`/`events.once` wait.

members.name: EventEmitterError.OPERATION_ABORTED
members.description:
Create an `EventEmitterError` wrapping `cause`, used when an `AbortSignal` aborts a pending
`events.on` or `events.once` wait.

params.name: cause
params.description: The abort reason wrapped by the error.

params.name: msg
params.description: An optional custom message for the wrapping error.

members.name: EventEmitterError.UNHANDLED_ERROR
members.description:
Create an `EventEmitterError` wrapping `cause`, used when an `'error'` event is emitted with no
listeners attached.

params.name: cause
params.description: The underlying error wrapped by the error.

params.name: msg
params.description: An optional custom message for the wrapping error.

Event

interface Event {
  readonly type: string

  readonly cancelable: boolean

  readonly isTrusted: boolean

}

params.name: type

params.name: options
